content.text:
Here are some **free online auto repair estimate tools** you can try:

1. **RepairPal Estimator** — Good for common mechanical repairs like brakes, alternator, starter, water pump, check-engine issues, etc. It gives fair price ranges based on parts, labor, and location. ([repairpal.com](https://repairpal.com/estimator/repair-services?utm_source=openai))

2. **YourMechanic Instant Estimates** — Free online estimates for mobile mechanic services and common repairs. ([yourmechanic.com](https://www.yourmechanic.com/estimates/?utm_source=openai))

3. **AAA Auto Repair Estimate Tool** — Useful for maintenance and repair cost estimates, especially if you want to compare with AAA Approved Auto Repair shops. ([aaa.com](https://www.aaa.com/autorepair/estimate?sf210106489=1&utm_source=openai))

4. **Instant Estimator** — Better for **auto body/collision repair** like dents, scrapes, bumper damage, and accident repairs. ([instantestimator.com](https://www.instantestimator.com/?utm_source=openai))

5. **VTCCO AI Damage Estimate** — Lets you upload vehicle damage photos for a free AI-based collision/body repair estimate. ([vtcco.com](https://vtcco.com/?utm_source=openai))

**Tip:** Online estimates are usually ballpark numbers. For an accurate quote, you’ll need your vehicle’s **year, make, model, engine size, ZIP code**, and a clear description of the problem—or photos if it’s body damage. Get 2–3 quotes before approving work.
